clock: t is seconds since the scenario's first hook

scenarios.one-subagent: One Agent call; the main agent ends its turn and is woken when the sub-agent ends.
scenarios.two-subagents-together: Two sub-agents end within 600 ms; a main-agent Stop with an empty inventory precedes the second notification.
scenarios.subagent-ends-mid-turn: The sub-agent ends while the main agent is still in its launching turn; the notification follows the next tool call.
scenarios.subagent-task-stopped: The main agent stops its sub-agent with TaskStop: a `killed` notification, no SubagentStop.
scenarios.subagent-resumed: A finished sub-agent is resumed with SendMessage; the same id stops and notifies a second time.
scenarios.subagent-with-own-shell: A sub-agent launches a background shell and stops; the shell's end resumes the sub-agent, never the main agent.
scenarios.subagent-then-typed-prompt: A prompt is typed while a notification is still queued behind a foreground tool.
scenarios.subagent-idle-ctrl-c: Ctrl+C at the idle prompt kills the background sub-agent with no hook and no notification; a typed prompt follows.
scenarios.two-shells-together: Two background shells end together; a main-agent Stop with an empty inventory precedes the second notification.
scenarios.shell-ends-mid-turn: A background shell ends and is notified before the launching turn's Stop.
scenarios.shell-task-stopped: The main agent stops its shell with TaskStop: no notification at all.
scenarios.monitor-events: A Monitor task sends `<event>` prompts under its task id while running, then a final one with a `<status>`.

note: Claude Code driven over a real PTY with every hook logged. Payloads are reduced to the fields the capture hook kept (event name, agent ids, tool name/input/response, prompt, task and cron inventories, stop_hook_active, source, notification_type); a launch response longer than the capture limit is reduced to isAsync/status/agentId. Scrubbed: session ids zeroed, home and scratch paths replaced.
